g.text: CALMS interventions localize to low-margin WSE decisions while preserving selective accuracy

text.style: font-size: 8.3px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #3f4852

g.text: A, Top-1 exchanges from WSE to frozen CALMS v1.0 (internal Full23 v1.3.2), stratified by WSE margin quartile; bar labels are query counts and bar heights are percentages

text.style: font-size: 8.3px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #3f4852

g.text: within quartile. B, closed-set selective Recall@1 (shading: 95% formula-cluster bootstrap intervals). GNPS Gold/Silver is consumed development evidence and every query

text.style: font-size: 8.3px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #3f4852

g.text: contains its true candidate; these curves do not evaluate no-match/open-set rejection, false-match FDR, or a deployable acceptance threshold.
